newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Oct 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Oct 2.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Wednesday:

* Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat are to meet on Wednesday for a second private meeting to try to ease tensions in their region. Netanyahu, Arafat and their aides met in private during a summit in Washington on Tuesday.
* U.S. Supreme Court agreed to decide if the country's constitution gives terminally ill patients the right to a doctor's assistance in quickening death.

* U.S. federal district court rejected presidential candidate Ross Perot's argument that the presidential debates between President Bill Clinton and Republican rival Bob Dole ought to be cancelled unless he was included.
